name: musicmute-backend
description: MusicMute API with external MongoDB and Redis services

scripts.start:dev: env -u HOST APP_ENV=local NODE_ENV=development nest start --watch
scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:secrets && pnpm test && pnpm run test:e2e && pnpm run build
scripts.test:dashboard:integration: pnpm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/admin-*.integration.mjs test/apk-verifier.integration.mjs test/release-upload.integration.mjs test/dashboard-contract.integration.mjs
scripts.test:deletion:integration: pnpm run build && node --test test/account-deletion-request.integration.mjs test/account-deletion.integration.mjs test/account-recovery.integration.mjs
scripts.test:auth:integration: pnpm run build && node --test test/auth.integration.mjs test/users.integration.mjs test/devices.integration.mjs test/app-policy.integration.mjs test/rate-limits.integration.mjs test/operations.integration.mjs test/firebase-tokens.integration.mjs test/helpers/isolated-services.test.mjs
scripts.test:processing:integration: pnpm run build && node --test test/processing-persistence.integration.mjs test/processing-usage.integration.mjs test/job-actions.integration.mjs test/push-registrations.integration.mjs test/notifications.integration.mjs test/abuse-protection.integration.mjs
